items.item: Every status column heading shows the status name and its ticket count, and the count equals the cards shown or the column states how many are not shown (such as "Showing 20 of 134")
items.evidence:
Column

renders `${s.label}` plus ``, set via `$('count-'+s.key).textContent = fmtCount(items.length)` where items is the exact filtered array rendered as
  • cards below (renderBoard) — e.g. screenshot shows 'Mới 9' with 9 cards, 'Chờ phản hồi khách 8' with 8 cards. No truncation logic exists, so count always equals cards shown.

items.item: Each card shows the ticket number (such as #4821), subject, customer, priority as a word or code (such as "P1 · Urgent") and the assignee, or an explicit "Unassigned"
items.evidence: cardHtml() renders `${t.id}` (e.g. TK-1005), the clamped title, `${t.customer.name}`, `${t.priority}` as a word (e.g. 'Khẩn cấp'), and either an initials avatar + `${t.assignee}` or `Chưa gán` (explicit 'Unassigned').

items.item: Open tickets show the time left to the next SLA target and which target it is (such as "Resolution due in 2h 15m"), and breached tickets show how long they are overdue (such as "Breached 40m ago") in text or with an icon, not by colour alone
items.evidence: slaInfo() only ever labels the timer generically as 'Hết hạn' (due) / 'Quá hạn' (overdue) — it never names which SLA target (e.g. first response vs. resolution) is being tracked, and the countdown is rounded to whole hours only (fmtDuration: `Math.round(Math.abs(ms)/3600000)` → '4 giờ'), not a precise 'Xh Ym' value. The overdue pill text does exist (not colour-only), but the 'which target' requirement is unmet.

items.item: Tickets in a waiting status (such as "Waiting on customer") show their SLA timer as paused instead of counting down
items.evidence: slaInfo(t): `const open = t.status === 'new' || t.status === 'in_progress' || t.status === 'waiting';` — 'waiting' tickets are treated identically to 'new'/'in_progress' and keep counting down to dueAt (screenshot: 'Chờ phản hồi khách' column cards still show 'Quá hạn 4 ngày' countdown pills, no paused indicator).

items.item: Within each column the cards are ordered by SLA due time or by priority, and the board states which ordering is used
items.evidence: renderBoard sorts with `.sort((a,b) => PRIORITY_BY_NAME[a.priority].rank - PRIORITY_BY_NAME[b.priority].rank || a.dueAt - b.dueAt)` (priority then due date), but no column or board text anywhere states this ordering — no 'Sorted by priority' label exists in the markup.

items.item: Search finds tickets by number, subject or customer, and filters cover assignee (including "Me" and "Unassigned"), priority and SLA state (such as breached or due within 1 hour)
items.evidence: matching() searches `t.id + ' ' + t.title + ' ' + t.customer.name` (covers number/subject/customer), and filters include #f-assignee (with '__unassigned' option) plus #btn-mine ('Giao cho tôi'/Assign to me) and #f-priority. However there is no SLA-state filter (breached / due within 1 hour) anywhere in the filter bar markup or `matching()` logic.

items.item: Each card has keyboard-reachable actions to assign the ticket (including "Assign to me") and to change its status without dragging, with accessible names that include the ticket number
items.evidence: The per-card kebab button `aria-label="Hành động cho ${t.id}"` opens a menu populated only with `STATUS_DEFS.filter(s => s.key !== t.status)` (status-change options, keyboard reachable, accessible name includes ticket id) — this covers status change without dragging. But there is no per-card assign action or 'Assign to me' shortcut; assignment is only possible by opening the side panel and manually picking a name from a generic #panel-assignee <select>, with no dedicated 'assign to me' control.

items.item: An empty column shows a short message instead of blank space, a search or filter with no matches offers to clear it, and loading and failed-load (with retry) states exist
items.evidence:
Empty column: `
  • Không có ticket ở trạng thái "${s.label}"
    • `. No-match filter state: `data-state="empty"` block with title 'Không tìm thấy ticket nào khớp với bộ lọc này' and `#empty-action` button labelled 'Xóa bộ lọc' wired to clearFilters(). Loading state: `data-state="loading"` skeleton block with `aria-busy="true"`. Error state: `data-state="error"` block with `#retry` button ('Thử lại').

items.item: Every relative time (such as "Updated 3h ago") also exposes the exact date, time and timezone, in a <time datetime> element or a title attribute
items.evidence: Panel body: `<time datetime="${t.createdAt.toISOString()}">${fmtDateTime(t.createdAt)} · ${fmtRelative(t.createdAt)}</time>` combines the relative text with an absolute datetime attribute (ISO string, implies timezone). Activity log entries similarly use `<time datetime="${a.at.toISOString()}">${fmtDateTime(a.at)}</time>`. No bare relative-only text exists elsewhere on cards (sla.line always shows the absolute fmtDateTime string).

tells: emoji-icon — panel close button uses a raw unicode glyph `✕` (id=panel-close) and the per-card actions button uses `⋯` (data-menu) instead of a real icon/SVG.
notes: Automated audit.json reports score 100 with zero violations, but several manual checklist items fail: waiting tickets don't pause their SLA timer, SLA target naming/precision is weak, column sort order is undocumented in the UI, SLA-state filtering is absent, and there is no per-card assign/'assign to me' action (only status-change via kebab menu).
